At the beginning of every combat this jar lures three swarms of large wasps to your aid.

You carefully lift the Jar of Wasp Honey, its golden contents shimmering with a strange allure. The faint sound of buzzing fills the air, as if the jar holds the promise of swarms eager to answer your call.

{Wasp Stinger}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +4 and grants all units in your army a 7% chance to cast Poison on enemies after attacking.
You grasp the Wasp Stinger, its long, sleek, venom-tipped edge pulsing faintly with a deadly energy. The artifact hums in your hand, a reminder of wasp's wrath and the power now at your command.

{Wasp Wings}

This item increases your units' speed by +1 and grants access to the Air Magic spell - Jump.

You pick up the Wasp Wings, their delicate, translucent form radiating an otherworldly energy. A sudden rush of agility flows through you, and the power to leap great distances now resides at your fingertips.

hero.new-monsters-pack.kurek-creatures.n:
Xanthor is a university professor, and the court sage of Roland and Catherine. Xanthor made many journeys across Antagarich. He had extensive knowledge of the creatures of the land, and a keen interest in geography. On his journey to Tatalia, he was accompanied by his colleague Marcus Finch and the guide Korbac, the latter of which saved Xanthor's life when they were attacked by some creatures of Nighon. Xanthor was also called in to advise the Royal Erathian Military Command after the death of Nicolas Gryphonheart, when General Kendal needed information about what was going on.
Roland and Catherine were at sea off the shore of Jadame when Escaton performed the Convocation of Cataclysm, and Xanthor was with them. There was a large Regnan pirate fleet in their way, so they were unable to land in Ravenshore until the Hero of Jadame had cleared them away.
Xanthor began to study Escaton's crystal and realized that the forces of the Elemental Planes were attacking Enroth. He asked the hero and their party to enter the four planes and retrieve a hearthstone from each. He used them to create a Conflux Key that allowed the party to enter the crystal and reach the Plane Between Planes in order to stop Escaton.
When Escaton's crystal was destroyed, Xanthor announced that when the Ironfists went back home, he would remain in Jadame, eager to study both the continent and the remains of the crystal.
Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Scholars or Lecturers for each level attained after 5th level.

Agar is one of the most well-known Warlocks of Enroth. His laboratories in the underground of Kriegspire inspire fear even among the local inhabitants, even after the war with Archibald ended. To this day, new varieties of dreadful beholders, bred by the Warlock, are discovered near the castle and in its hidden passages.

It is said that Agar is now hiding from King Roland Ironfist's henchmen and preparing to perform the Ritual of Eternal Night, which will allow the mad scholar to conduct his terrifying experiments indefinitely, without worrying about future aging ailments or declining mental acuity.

His former apprentice, Xantor, now a historian and researcher of Enroth, wrote in his notes- Agar is becoming like the creators. In his mad desire to become a god, he creates the most dreadful forms of life that human eyes can witness. 

Specialization – Terrible Eyes.
Upgrades Evil Eyes to Terrible Eyes

Bumblewasp, the great hero of the wasps, is a tireless champion devoted to the well-being of the hive. With a robust golden-striped body and powerful wings, he ventures far and wide, collecting the finest nectar to craft potent honey that restores vitality to all who partake. Revered for his bravery and selflessness, Bumblewasp is a symbol of resilience and the hive’s unwavering spirit.

Buzzer, a slender yet influential wasp hero, commands respect with his sharp mind and strategic prowess. Despite his lean form, he possesses the power to summon a swarm of wasp sentries, creating a formidable defense on the battlefield. His tactical brilliance ensures his enemies are constantly surrounded by a relentless, ever-watchful army.
Casts Summon Wasp Sentry spell with increased effect.

{Summon Wasp Sentries}

Casts Summon Wasp Sentry spell with increased effect.

Hell Hornet, the leader of the most aggressive wasps and hornets, strikes terror into the hearts of his enemies with his fierce green form and savage presence. A relentless force of nature, he commands his swarm with brutal precision, fueling their fury with the powerful spells Berserk and Bloodlust. Under his command, his forces become an unstoppable tide of rage, leaving nothing but destruction in their wake.
Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Wasp Warriors for each level attained after 1st level.

{Wasp Warrior}

Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Wasp Warriors

Killerbee, the light blue wasp hero, is a master of mobility and surprise, wielding the power of the enhanced Jump spell. His translucent azure wings shimmer with magical energy, allowing him to empower his units with the ability to leap great distances in battle. Under his guidance, the swarm gains unmatched agility, turning the battlefield into a chaotic dance of precise strikes and evasive maneuvers.
Casts Jump on at least advanced level of mastery.

Ohnobug is a fearsome and eerie wasp captain, towering with a thin, elongated black body. His unsettling presence strikes terror into all who face him. Specializing in summoning powerful wasp warriors, Ohnobug commands an army of fearsome fighters that wreak havoc on the battlefield. His chilling appearance and lethal swarm leave no hope for his enemies, who are overpowered by his unrelenting force.
Casts Summon Wasp Warrior spell with increased effect.

{Summon Wasp Warriors}

Casts Summon Wasp Warrior spell with increased effect.

Stingers, the fearsome wasp hero, is a master of venomous warfare, inspiring his allies to strike with lethal precision. With sleek, jet-black wings and a brown venom-coated stinger that gleams in battle, he leads his units with unmatched ferocity. Under his command, the swarm gains a potent venom bonus, turning every attack into a deadly poison that ensures their enemies' swift demise.
All creatures receive chance to poison target after attack.

Swarmer, the red-eyed wasp hero, is a fearsome master of the Wasp Swarm spell, summoning clouds of tiny wasps to overwhelm his foes. His crimson gaze and thick, chitinous armor strike fear into enemies as the buzzing hordes obey his every command. With Swarmer's magic, the battlefield becomes a whirlwind of stinging chaos, ensuring his enemies are outnumbered and outmatched.
Casts Wasp Swarm with more damage increasing level by level.

Wasp General, second only to the Queen, stands as the highest-ranking wasp and a formidable military leader. With an imposing figure, razor-sharp mandibles, and a commanding presence, he leads swarms of wasp workers and sentries into battle with ruthless precision. Known for his unmatched strength and unwavering loyalty, the Wasp General ensures the hive's enemies are crushed under the might of his disciplined armies.
Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Wasp Workers or Wasp Sentries for each level attained after 1st level.
Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Wasp Workers or Wasp Sentries

Wasp Queen Alvaria is the majestic ruler of all wasps, her domain stretching across the ancient forests and canyons of Alvar, where her honey palace stands as a symbol of power and unity. With shimmering wings and piercing shiny eyes, she commands her countless subjects with an aura of regal authority and natural ferocity. Allies may earn her devastating swarm’s aid, while enemies face her unrelenting wrath and venomous vengeance.

Zeet is a powerful wasp hero from ancient nests, commanding respect with his sharp mind and mastery over swarms. He specializes in summoning wasp workers, using them to overwhelm enemies in battle. His tactical brilliance ensures his foes are always outsmarted and outnumbered, falling before his relentless, coordinated swarms.
Casts Summon Wasp Worker spell with increased effect.

{Summon Wasp Workers}

Casts Summon Wasp Worker spell with increased effect.

She has a great talent for finding an oases in the desert. She once even accidentally found a desert geyser called the Holy Source of Life. Nowadays she often goes there with her army, which makes her troops more vital than other troops found in the desert.
Increases hit points of all units in the army by 2.

Amshah was one of the flagellants freed from captivity by Ja'Bak. After his liberation, he decided to stay in Tilafa, where he found a new life and mission. Today, he is responsible for other escapees from cities occupied by knights, providing them with shelter and assistance in adapting to their new reality. With his experience and knowledge, he has become a mentor and leader, helping former prisoners find their way in freedom and build new, stable lives in Tilafa. His courage and determination are an inspiration to many who have endured similar traumas.

In cities of wizards, there is little room for women, especially for women like Ankh-Amon, for whom expanding knowledge is less important than enhancing magical talent. After years of wandering, she found her place among the viziers in the Bracada desert.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill.
Basha loves trinkets, in particular affection has for crystals. She can find even the smallest crystal hidden in desert sands, which makes her one of the most respected nobles of the desert.
Increases kingdom's income by 1 crystal per day

Anubians are known for their magical nature, but Bianor have always been fascinated with engineering. He brought a few ballistas to his palace basement, where he got them upgraded. During battles his war mashines can kill up to 20 people with a single shot.
Increases the Attack and Defence skill of Ballista for each level attained after 4th level.

Pharaoh Honsuneb is a legendary ruler who can command powerful desert winged serpents. His ability to control these mythical creatures brings him great strength and respect among his subjects. With his power, Honsuneb maintains order and security in his kingdom.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Wadjets or Venomous Wadjets for each level attained after 2nd level.

Pharaoh Inpu is a legendary ruler known for his extraordinary magical abilities. Through mysterious rituals, he can transform sphinxes of various subspecies, including living and undead sphinxes, lamias, manticores, and scorpicores, into powerful guardian sphinxes. His reign is a time of great protection and stability, as the guardian sphinxes guard the borders of his kingdom against all threats.
pgrades various creatures into sphinxes. These creatures are: Sphinxes, Sphinx Oracles, Lamias, Ashen Sphinxes, Entombed Sphinxes, Manticores and Scorpicores.
Creature Bonus: Can change various hybrids into Guardian Sphinxes
As everyone knows, Sekhmets do not like to hurry, they do everything gracefully and calmly. But Isham is different, when riding her horse she can overtake other riders with the speed of a sandstorm.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill.
The Supreme Pharaoh, the greatest lord of the Bracada desert, charismatic Anubis hungry for power. During his reign, the great Golden City became the largest trade center in the south Antagarich.
Hero can change Anubises and Divine Anubises into unique Anubis Sabre Warriors

Some Sekhmets do not believe in their own resurrection, but legends do not lie. Keknutt is a good example; she died and rose from the dead with a new appearance. Now, instead of being half lion and half human, she looks like a humanoid frog. She tells her sister that she believed in the resurrection and was not afraid of death. Inspired by her story and transformation, all Sekhmets now go into battle without fear, confident in the promise of resurrection and emboldened by Keknutt's miraculous return.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Sekhmet or Sekhmet Priestiess for each level attained after 4th level.

Kemi hails from Tatalia. She was an apprentice blacksmith who learned everything from her master before moving south. The swampy areas never suited her, so she settled within the protective walls of Shazad, where she served as a blacksmith for the army. After becoming very popular, she overthrew a local pharaoh and took his place on the throne.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill.

He hails from Bracada and graduated from the prestigious Academy of Mages, where he specialized in the intricate and ancient desert aspects of earth magic. Driven by an insatiable thirst for knowledge and power, he left his hometown after a few years to seek out more potent and elusive forms of magic. The mystical allure of the desert cities captivated him, and he chose to settle there. Immersed in the enigmatic and harsh landscapes, he honed his magical abilities to new heights, delving deep into the secrets of the sands and the earth. His journey through the deserts not only enhanced his powers but also transformed him into a mage of formidable skill and wisdom.
Casts more quicksand pools on the battlefield.

Deserts always hide treasures, as Mentuhotep firmly believes. He is proven right whenever he discoveres great riches there. Subsequently, he settled in one of the desert cities, where he expanded his wealth.
Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold pieces per day

Mex-Nefer began to serve in the temple of the Four Winds since childhood. Through years she was known both for her great wisdom and also cruelty. For her cruelty was banished from the city. But after spending a long time in the desert, she learned to predict the behavior of the wind, and use it for their own purposes and recall at the appropriate time.
Casts Haste with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).

They say that it was Netsutset who brought the ammuts to the cities. The first ammuts were summoned from some kind of terrifying realm via a dark ritual ordered by Netsutset and performed by crocodile priests. Despite their wild nature, he managed to tame and train these otherworldly beings.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Ammuts or Sun Ammuts for each level attained after 5th level.

Ta-Kem spent her whole life studying various scrolls about geology. When times have changed and he was sent to war, she learned to use the acquired knowledge in practice, so she can always find firmer ground to move quickly.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Pathfinding skill.

Uzziah, the right-handed knopesh master, found his best camel alone in the depths of the dunes. It soon turned out, that it is the fastest camel known to everyone across the desert, so Uzziah named him Me'nzzen, which means 'Leader of the party'. He didn't have to wait a long time until many other camel riders came to him to ride under his banner. Now, together they roam the desert spreading terror among the enemies of the Grand Pharaoh.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Camel Riders or Desert Warriors for each level attained after 3rd level.

mapObject.new-monsters-pack.kurek-creatu: Lurking just inside this Lair are some loathesome evil eyes and the treasure they have stolen from unwary travelers. Do you dare to lurk inside?
The lair has been raided. The only things you find are smelly and rotting remains of various types of beholders.
You approach the the infamous Marine Serail. Lewd, lascivious sounds and lights emanate from within. Do you wish to come inside?
This Marine Serail is filled with water and no longer holds any treasures.

The hive emits a hum, which sets your teeth rattling in your jaw. The breeze you feel is not the wind, but the blowback of a thousand monstrous wings. Battling the wasps is a true test of strength – the Queen, endowed with immense power, can summon vast numbers of guardians. Defeating this monarch will require courage and wit. Will you dare to enter?

The halls of the Wasp Queen's palace stand silent, the once-buzzing swarm now defeated. The sweet scent of honey lingers, a reminder of the battle fought here. Nothing remains but the echoes of triumph.
You encounter a flock of wild griffins. Their screeches fill the air as they prepare to defend their nest. Do you wish to attack?
This Griffin Nest has been abandoned and holds no further interest.
